registration.$comment: baselineY is this plate MEASURED base, not a normalized target — the five span 2086..2092 (6px). Plates are locked AS GENERATED: running them through normalize-plate would measure the contact shadow as part of the body and rescale them. Neck registration (the number closures depend on) agrees to 4px.

provenance.source: gpt-image-2 shadow pass over Nano-Banana material lock

entries.notes: Shadowed true-north body. Supersedes the shadow-less plate of the same id. Verified 2026-08-01: across all five colorways the neck silhouette agrees to a mean 4px over the 211px strip y=760..971, centerline within 3px, so ONE closure recipe seats on every plate without per-bottle tuning.
